description:
Replace the ad-hoc, two-contract render pipeline (top-level
`Component.render(state, width) :: [binary]` vs transcript
`Component.render(state, ctx) :: {state, lines, frame_ms}`) and the
hand-stitched `Interactive.build_screen/2` with a single composable,
memoized component model.

Components become functions that return a `%VNode{}` tree. A single
recursive paint phase walks the tree once, writing into a `LineBuf`
(an iodata accumulator with visible-width tracking) — no
`++`/`flat_map`/`List.flatten` in the hot path. Hooks (`use_state`,
`use_memo`, `use_frame`, `use_key`, `use_effect`) provide local
state, memoization, animation, and key handling without bespoke
plumbing per region. OSC 133 zone welding becomes a regular
`%VZone{}` node rather than a post-pass walker. The terminal cursor
becomes a zero-width `%VCursor{}` leaf whose `{row,col}` is stamped
into the buffer and lifted into the renderer's existing
`cursor_seq`. Custom widgets stop escaping the type system through
`{from, %{render: …}}`.

Goals (single contract; nested composition; per-component memo;
single-pass paint; first-class animation; OSC welding via VZone;
`use_frame` aggregated into a single deadline that drives RenderLoop).
Non-goals (no DOM diff in the React sense; no JSX/sigils in v1; no
global stores; lines remain the output unit).

Design deck: `tmp/tui_react_proposal.html` (sections 1–12: today's
pain, goals, model, component API, hooks, layout, cursor-as-VNode,
OSC welding, performance contract, reconciler, migration plan, open
questions).

The migration is sequenced so the codebase stays bilingual: a
`Compat` adapter wraps any legacy `Component.render/2` as a
`%VLines{}` leaf until every region is converted, then the adapter
and feature flag are removed.
title: TUI: React-style functional component system (VDom → LineBuf)
